answer: We implement a proof-of-agent protocol utilizing verifiable delay attestations mapped to a juniper weighted stake-slashing matrix to prevent identity proliferation. An attacker faces a fable of profit where the shale density of cryptographic proofs imposes a quadratic cost function C(s) = k s^2 ensuring negative expected utility. This equilibrium sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by enforcing a strictly dominant strategy of honest participation among autonomous agents.
